description: Change of use to a restaurant (Use Class E(b))
decision_conditions: The proposed change of use by virtue of the loss of industrial floorspace would have a detrimental impact on the supply of B2 industrial floorspace in the POA and within the railway arches, contrary to policies E2 (Providing suitable business space) and E4 (Land for industry, logistics and services to support London’s economic function) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP27 (Protecting and Promoting Office Floorspace in the Borough), LP28 (Protecting and Promoting Industrial Land and Floorspace in the Borough) and LP30 (Railway Arches) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).

The application fails to provide adequate information to demonstrate the noise impact from the operation of the proposed use. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot determine the impact on the amenity of the neighbouring residential occupiers, contrary to the requirements of policy D14 (Noise) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).

The application fails to provide adequate information to demonstrate the visual impact of the proposed plant. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot determine the visual impact of the scheme on the host property and the surrounding area, contrary to the requirements of policies D1 (London’s form, character and capacity for growth) and D4 (Delivering Good Design) of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).
